caption: The drawing depicts a carved statue of a standing female figure with medium brown skin and long straight dark hair. The figure raises her right hand palm-out while her left arm rests close to her side. She wears a feathered headdress colored in green, red, and yellow, a red top with short sleeves and green trim, and a knee-length cream-colored skirt decorated with a zigzag green and red pattern at the hem. The figure's legs are covered with black coverings that reach up to her knees and end in brown shoes or moccasins. Resting on her left shoulder is a small child or infant, whose upper body and face are visible, blending into the color palette of the main figure. The statue stands on a square wooden base, and the background of the drawing is plain and light beige. The overall composition is vertically oriented, with the attention centered on the figure's detailed pose and attire.
title: Cigar Store Indian
